hook_text: Every plant in this garden is South African, but they would never meet in the wild.
clip_script: Kirstenbosch, Cape Town. Fynbos with tough little leaves and proteas as big as your fist: made for wet winters and dry summers, and renewed by fire. A walkway through tall forest trees, which need rain all year. A glasshouse as dry as a desert: succulents storing water in fat leaves, and a baobab with a water-tank trunk. Natural vegetation grows on its own, and every plant is adapted to its climate.
visual_style: Whiteboard protea, then tall forest trees, then succulents and a baobab, each matched with a little climate symbol.
mood: Fascinated and peaceful, like a walk in a garden.
pacing: Slow, a few steps through each kind of vegetation.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find an indigenous plant growing near your home.
